meta.name: OpenCAWR — Car Analysis / What's it Really cost
meta.basis: drive-to-death lifetime cost per mile; user profile: 13k mi/yr, USAA active-duty, Florida reg, Fresno CA garaging
meta.provenance_note: Established vehicles use hand-curated curves anchored to real cars.com/iSeeCars pulls + owner-reported longevity. Reliability tiers were RE-DERIVED 2026-07-29 from NHTSA complaint data alone (public domain, keyless) per docs/reliability-methodology.md — spec §9's Consumer Reports launch gate is cleared for the seed set; no CR, CarComplaints or RepairPal data is used. The 2 'sport' rows are an owner carve-out and are never derived. The derivation is a coarse ordering built on complaint mix, not a measured defect rate — read the methodology's 'Known limitations'. Vehicles in 'proxied' were estimated from segment peers (no used history).
